en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 17. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Barqi, from ‘Abdil ‘Aďīm Al-Ḥasani, from Ḥasan (ibn ‘Ali Al-Washā), from Abī Salamah, who said:
Ja’far ibn Muḥammad (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: The heavens have never wept over anyone other than Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā (a.s.) and Ḥusain (a.s.).
